svg.title: Clustering at work
svg.desc: Six small illustrations. Top row, clustering on its own: a phylogenetic tree with colored clades, cells grouped into cell types, and a network split into communities. Bottom row, clustering inside machine-learning systems: nearest-neighbor search that visits only the clusters closest to a query, self-supervised learning with cluster assignments as pseudo-labels, and documents organized into a tree of clusters and summaries for retrieval.
